articles.title: A Dietitian Reveals 5 Red Flags
articles.description: Veena V, Chief Clinical Dietician at Aster Whitefield Hospital, Bengaluru, warns that consumers are frequently misled by catchy marketing trends when purchasing popular protein supplements. She outlines five major red flags: high added sugar content, overly long ingredient lists full of artificial additives, hidden stimulants like caffeine, using powders as improper meal replacements, and consuming extra protein without tracking daily bodily requirements.

articles.title: Here's Why Apple is Reportedly Skipping M6 Pro and M6 Max Chips
articles.description: According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple will be releasing a regular M6 chip, but it has no plans to offer higher-end M6 Pro and M6 Max chips. In his Power On newsletter today, he said the reason for this break in tradition is AI. "Apple had been planning major neural-processing upgrades for the M7 family and ultimately decided those improvements were important enough to justify accelerating the next generation rather than completing the M6 lineup," he explained.
